facts.text: Named after Albert B. Simpson, founder of the Christian and Missionary Alliance (C&MA), Simpson University became the official western region school of the C&MA in 1941.

sources.title: Institutional Identity - Redding - Simpson University
sources.quote: The University was named after Albert B. Simpson, late nineteenth and early 20th century pastor and revivalist who pioneered the Bible school movement in North America and founded the Christian and Missionary Alliance (C&MA).
